title: OBE Curriculum: B.Sc. (Honours) in Forestry (Session 2025-26)
courseTitle: Department of Forestry and Environmental Science, SUST
description: Official Outcome-Based Education (OBE) curriculum approved for B.Sc. (Honours) in Forestry covering all 8 semesters, 160 credits, course outlines, and grading policies.

title: FES 08211121: Introduction to Forestry Core Lecture Presentations
description: Comprehensive coverage: Forest stratification, world forest biomes, Bangladesh forest types, and institutional setup.

title: FES 08211121: Semester Final Examination Question Paper (2023-2024)
description: Official final examination question paper covering Part A and Part B with Bloom’s taxonomy mapping.

title: FES 08211221: Diagnostic Botanical Keys for Forest Trees of Bangladesh
description: Family identification keys for Dipterocarpaceae, Fabaceae, Verbenaceae, Meliaceae, Moraceae, and mangrove species.

title: FES 08211221: Midterm & Semester Final Exam Question Archive
description: Compiled past 3 years questions including species-specific silviculture of Teak, Sal, Garjan, and Sundri.

title: FES 05322122: Forest Soil Mechanical Analysis & Chemical Testing Protocol
description: Complete protocol for hydrometer method soil texture, Walkley-Black organic matter, pH, and nitrogen determination.

title: FES 08212221: Principles of Silviculture & Stand Tending Systems
description: Detailed analysis of natural regeneration, Assisted Natural Regeneration (ANR), thinning types, and high/low forest systems.

title: FES 08213121: Tree Volume, Form Factors & Forest Inventory Handbook
description: Mathematical formulations for tree volume, stem taper equations, sample plot allocation, Bitterlich point sampling, and carbon accounting.

title: FES 08213121: Forest Mensuration & Inventory Final Examination (2023)
description: Official 60-mark final paper covering single tree measurement, site index equations, and sampling designs.

title: FES 05323221: Satellite Remote Sensing & Digital Image Processing Lecture Deck
courseTitle: Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System
description: Spectral reflectance of forest vegetation, Sentinel/Landsat satellite bands, false color composites, and supervised classification.

title: FES 05323222: QGIS Step-by-Step Laboratory Manual for Forestry GIS
description: Hands-on guide: Georeferencing, vector digitizing, polygon buffering, calculating NDVI, and map layout export.

title: FES 08214122: Forest Management Plan Preparation Guidelines & Sample Format
description: Detailed framework for authoring Part I (Past management) and Part II (Future prescriptions) of the official working plan.

title: FES 08214221: Bangladesh Forest Act 1927 & Wildlife Act 2012 Handbook
courseTitle: Forest & Environmental Policy, Law and Administration
authorOrTeacher: Prof. Dr. A. Z. M. Manzoor Rashid
description: Summarized legal sections: Reserved vs. Protected forests, transit rules, compoundable offences, CITES, and CBD obligations.

title: FES 05214221: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Case Studies & Guidelines
description: Screening and scoping checklists, Leopold interaction matrix, DoE clearance requirements, and environmental management plans (EMP).
